1. Acceptance of These Terms

These Terms of Service (the “Terms”) form a binding agreement between you and Acme Cloud Inc. (“Acme”, “we”, “us”). By creating an account, installing our desktop or mobile applications, or otherwise accessing the Acme Cloud storage and collaboration services (the “Service”), you confirm that you have read, understood and agree to be bound by these Terms and by our Privacy Notice, which is incorporated by reference. If you are using the Service on behalf of an organization, you represent that you have authority to bind that organization to these Terms. If you do not agree, you must not use the Service.

You must be at least 18 years old, or the age of legal majority where you live, to create an account. You are responsible for keeping your password confidential and for all activity that occurs under your account. You agree to notify us promptly if you suspect unauthorized access to your account. We are not responsible for losses caused by your failure to protect your credentials.
2. Description of the Service

Acme Cloud provides online file storage, file synchronization across devices, document previews, shared folders and basic collaboration features such as comments and version history. Features vary by plan and may be added, changed or removed over time. Some features rely on third-party infrastructure providers located in different countries, and the availability of the Service may depend on those providers. We do our best to keep the Service available, but we do not promise that it will be uninterrupted or error-free, and scheduled maintenance may occasionally make parts of the Service unavailable.
3. Subscriptions, Billing and Renewal

Paid plans are offered on a monthly or annual basis. Prices are displayed in your account settings before you subscribe, and applicable taxes are added at checkout. By starting a paid subscription you authorize Acme to charge your selected payment method for the subscription fee and any applicable taxes.

Your subscription will automatically renew at the end of each billing period and your payment method will be charged the then-current fee unless you cancel at least 48 hours before the renewal date. Cancellation can only be completed by contacting our billing team through the support portal; deleting the app or your files does not cancel your subscription.

All payments are non-refundable, including for partially used subscription periods and for storage you did not use, except where a refund is required by applicable law. If a payment fails, we may suspend paid features until the outstanding balance is paid, and we may retry the charge using any payment method on file.

Promotional prices and free trials are available only to new customers, are limited to one per household, and convert into a regular paid subscription at the end of the promotional period unless cancelled in the same way described above.

Our Privacy Notice explains what personal data we collect, including account details, device identifiers, approximate location derived from your IP address, and information about how you use the Service. We use this information to operate and secure the Service, to provide customer support, and to understand how our features are used. We keep backup copies of deleted files for up to 30 days so that they can be restored if they were removed by mistake.

The Service may let you connect third-party applications, such as office suites, calendar tools, password managers or photo editors. When you connect an integration, you authorize Acme to exchange the data needed for that integration to work, such as file names, file contents you choose to open, and basic account details. The partner is responsible for the features it provides, and support requests about those features should be sent to the partner directly. We will tell you in the integration settings which company provides each feature, and you can disconnect an integration at any time from your account page.

Beta features may be less reliable than the rest of the Service, may change significantly, and may be discontinued at any time. Please do not rely on beta features to store the only copy of important files. Your use of beta features is voluntary, and you can opt out of preview programs in your account settings.

If you send us comments, suggestions or ideas about the Service, we may use them to improve our products without any obligation to you. We appreciate feedback and read every message sent to the product team, although we cannot reply to all of them individually.

blocks.text: Each plan includes a storage allowance that is shown on the pricing page and in your account. If you exceed your allowance, you will not be able to upload new files until you free up space or upgrade your plan; existing files will remain available for download. Very large numbers of small files, extremely high download volumes or automated access patterns may be limited to protect the stability of the Service for other users. We will contact you before applying such limits whenever possible, and we will explain what you can do to bring your usage back within normal levels.

blocks.text: Free accounts that have not been used for twelve months may be placed in an archived state. Archived files can be restored by signing in and following the instructions on the screen. We send reminder emails before an account is archived so that you have time to sign in or download your files.

If you encounter an accessibility barrier, please let our support team know and we will try to provide the information or functionality you need in an alternative format. Support is available by chat and email in English, German and Spanish during regular business hours, and our Help Center contains step-by-step guides for the most common tasks, including restoring deleted files, managing shared folders and changing your plan.
